'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes]]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli airstrikes]] on two villages in [[Baalbek]], [[Lebanon]], kill at least nineteen people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strikes-kill-19-people-including-eight-women-two-towns-lebanons-baalbek-2024-10-30/ (Reuters)]

**The [[United States military]] announces that [[US|American]] [[airstrike]]s in [[Syria]] earlier this week killed as many as 35 [[Islamic State]] members. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/united-states/2024/10/30/american-strikes-killed-up-to-35-extremists-in-syria-us-military- (Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Mozambican general election]]
**It is reported that at least ten people were killed and 63 others were injured by gunfire in post-election protests in [[Mozambique]] last week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-10-shot-dead-mozambique-post-election-protests-medical-associations-say-2024-10-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
**One person is killed while attempting to cross the [[English Channel]] in a [[dinghy]]. Three other bodies are found on beaches near [[Neufchâtel-Hardelot]] and [[Équihen-Plage]], [[France]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-dead-channel-crossing-attempt-french-authorities-say-2024-10-30/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed and eight others are injured in a [[Mass stabbing|stabbing]] [[Spree killing|spree]] in [[Kagadi]], [[Uganda]], by members of an unknown [[cult]]. Two attackers are killed by [[Uganda Police Force|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-cult-members-kill-eight-uganda-village-2024-10-30/ (Reuters)]
*The [[United Nations Security Council]] votes 15–0 to make changes to the [[United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM)|United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia]], forming a new mission called the United Nations Transitional Mission in Somalia, which is expected to begin operating on November 1. [https://www.miragenews.com/unsc-adopts-resolution-2753-transfers-somalia-1347633/ (Mirage News)]
